types.name: PING_SERVER
types.description: Connection and command-path probe. No game state change, no domain event. Introduced by p0-01-bootstrap; p0-02 sends it over the realtime connection to measure the command round trip through the tick loop.

types.name: PING_REPLY
types.description: Type-specific answer to an ACCEPTED PING_SERVER, produced in the tick that handled it. Always arrives after that command's COMMAND_RESULT.

types.name: COMMAND_RESULT
types.description: Adjudication result of one command: ACCEPTED (taken into the simulation on the envelope tick) or REJECTED with a reason code. Accepted is not completed. Introduced by p0-02-networking-spike.

types.name: SESSION_READY
types.description: First message on an authenticated realtime connection: session_id, world_id, the actor_id the server decided, tick_hz and the server build. Introduced by p0-02-networking-spike.

types.name: SESSION_OPENED
types.description: An authenticated actor became present in the world. Persisted to domain_events. Importance level 0 by design - it does not become a Historical Event. 'history' joins consumers when the history crate exists (p2). Introduced by p0-02-networking-spike.

types.name: SESSION_CLOSED
types.description: The presence interval opened by SESSION_OPENED ended, with the reason. Shares the opening event's correlation_id. Persisted to domain_events. Introduced by p0-02-networking-spike.
